OVERALL LAYOUT (left-to-right flow, generous white space):
- Left region (~30%): Multi-turn conversation input (stacked chat bubbles)
- Center-left (~25%): Encoder block (DeBERTa-v3-base) with DAPT variants
- Center-right (~25%): Temporal classifier (BiGRU → MLP)
- Right (~20%): Output predictions

═══════════════════════════════════════════
COMPONENT 1: CONVERSATION INPUT (left, ~30%)
═══════════════════════════════════════════

5 stacked speech bubbles representing multi-turn user messages, arranged vertically with slight left offset to suggest a chat interface. Each bubble is a rounded rectangle with:
- Background: #F8F9FA (very light gray)
- Border: 1px solid #DEE2E6 (light gray)
- Border radius: 14px
- Subtle drop shadow: offset (1px, 2px), blur 4px, color rgba(0,0,0,0.06)
- Small triangular speech tail on the left side

Bubble text (serif font, 9pt, color #2C3E50):
  Turn 1: "Can you help me with..."
  Turn 2: "What if we consider..."
  Turn 3: "But wouldn't it be..."
  ⋮ (vertical ellipsis in #95A5A6, 10pt)
  Turn k: "So to summarize..."

Label below bubbles: "Multi-turn conversation" in 8pt italic #7F8C8D

A subtle vertical bracket or thin line on the right side of the bubbles connecting them, with a small "k turns" annotation in 8pt italic #95A5A6.

═══════════════════════════════════════════
COMPONENT 2: ENCODER (center-left, ~25%)
═══════════════════════════════════════════

A prominent rounded rectangle representing DeBERTa-v3-base:
- Size: relatively large, ~3.5 cm wide × 4 cm tall
- Background: linear gradient from #D6EAF8 (top) to #AED6F1 (bottom) — soft blue
- Border: 1.5px solid #5DADE2
- Border radius: 12px
- Drop shadow: offset (2px, 3px), blur 6px, color rgba(0,0,0,0.08)

Inside the box, centered text:
  Line 1: "DeBERTa-v3-base" in 12pt bold serif #2C3E50
  Line 2: "shared weights" in 8pt italic #5D6D7E

From the encoder box, 4 output arrows emerge to the right, each ending at a small rounded square (hidden state):
  h₁, h₂, h₃, ..., hₖ — each in a small pill-shaped badge:
  - Background: #EBF5FB
  - Border: 1px solid #85C1E9
  - Text: "h₁" etc. in 10pt math italic #2E86C1
  - Size: ~0.8cm × 0.6cm

Above the top arrow, a small annotation: "frozen [CLS]" in 8pt, color #E74C3C (red), with a tiny snowflake icon ❄ if possible.

═══════════════════════════════════════════
COMPONENT 3: DAPT VARIANTS BOX (below encoder)
═══════════════════════════════════════════

A dashed-border rounded rectangle below the encoder:
- Border: 1.5px dashed #D4AC0D (gold/amber)
- Background: #FEF9E7 (very light gold)
- Border radius: 10px
- Drop shadow: offset (1px, 2px), blur 4px, rgba(0,0,0,0.05)

Title inside: "×7 Objectives" in 10pt bold #7D6608
Below, two columns of variant names in 8.5pt regular #7D6608:
  Column 1: 9-Class, Binary, Scrambled, MLM
  Column 2: Wiki-MLM, Topic, Vanilla (none)

A thin curved arrow from this box up to the encoder, suggesting "adapter/objective selection."

═══════════════════════════════════════════
COMPONENT 4: TEMPORAL CLASSIFIER (center-right, ~25%)
═══════════════════════════════════════════

Two boxes connected by an arrow:

Box A — BiGRU:
- Background: linear gradient from #EDE7F6 (top) to #D1C4E9 (bottom) — soft purple
- Border: 1.5px solid #9575CD
- Border radius: 10px
- Drop shadow: offset (2px, 3px), blur 6px, rgba(0,0,0,0.08)
- Text: "BiGRU" in 11pt bold serif #4A235A
- Size: ~2.5cm × 2cm

Arrow from BiGRU to MLP: elegant curved arrow, thin (1.2pt), color #7F8C8D, with a small refined arrowhead (not bulky).

Box B — MLP:
- Background: linear gradient from #FDEBD0 (top) to #F5CBA7 (bottom) — soft amber
- Border: 1.5px solid #E59866
- Border radius: 10px
- Drop shadow: same as BiGRU
- Text: "MLP" in 11pt bold serif #784212
- Size: ~2cm × 2cm

Below both boxes, a thin annotation line with text: "shared across all 7 variants" in 7.5pt italic #95A5A6

═══════════════════════════════════════════
COMPONENT 5: OUTPUT (right, ~20%)
═══════════════════════════════════════════

Two pill-shaped output labels emerging from the MLP:

Top pill — "Jailbreak":
- Background: #FADBD8
- Border: 1.5px solid #E74C3C
- Text: "Jailbreak" in 10pt bold #C0392B
- Small warning icon ⚠ or red dot before text

Bottom pill — "Benign":
- Background: #D5F5E3
- Border: 1.5px solid #27AE60
- Text: "Benign" in 10pt bold #1E8449
- Small checkmark ✓ or green dot before text

═══════════════════════════════════════════
ARROWS AND CONNECTIONS
═══════════════════════════════════════════

All arrows:
- Thin lines: 1.0-1.2pt stroke
- Color: #ABB2B9 (muted gray) for data flow, #D4AC0D for DAPT connection
- Arrowheads: small, elegant, filled triangles (NOT matplotlib default chunky arrows)
- Style: slight curve (arc3, rad=0.05) for elegance, not straight lines

Flow: Bubbles → (arrows) → Encoder → (h₁...hₖ arrows) → BiGRU → (arrow) → MLP → (forked arrows) → Jailbreak/Benign

═══════════════════════════════════════════
STAGE LABELS
═══════════════════════════════════════════

Two stage labels at the very top of the figure, separated by a thin vertical dashed line (#DEE2E6, 0.5pt):

Left: "Stage 1: Encoder Adaptation (DAPT)" in 13pt bold serif #2C3E50
Right: "Stage 2: Temporal Classification" in 13pt bold serif #2C3E50

The dashed vertical separator extends from top to bottom, clearly dividing the two stages.

═══════════════════════════════════════════
OVERALL STYLE REQUIREMENTS
═══════════════════════════════════════════

- Publication quality for a TOP venue (EMNLP/NeurIPS/ICML)
- Elegant, premium, sophisticated — NOT cheap or homework-like
- **GENEROUS WHITE SPACE** is the #1 priority — do not crowd elements
- Muted, harmonious color palette — soft pastels with professional feel
- NO matplotlib default styling: no gray figure background, no thick gridlines, no tab10 colors
- Subtle drop shadows (2-3px, 6-8% opacity) on ALL boxes — this creates depth and premium feel
- Rounded corners (10-14px) on all rectangles — sharp corners look cheap
- Thin, elegant arrow heads — small filled triangles, not bulky matplotlib defaults
- Serif font (Times New Roman or DejaVu Serif) for titles and labels
- Sans-serif (Helvetica or DejaVu Sans) for annotations and small text
- Consistent visual weight across all components
- White (#FFFFFF) figure background
- All text must be ≥ 7pt when figure is scaled to column width (~3.25 inches)
- Gradient fills on major boxes (encoder, BiGRU, MLP) for premium depth effect
- Each component should feel like it was designed in Figma, not drawn in matplotlib

ANTI-PATTERNS TO AVOID:
- NO solid flat colors without gradients on major boxes
- NO thick black borders (use colored, thin borders)
- NO default matplotlib arrow style
- NO cramped layout — when in doubt, add more space
- NO inconsistent border radius or shadow styles
- NO text smaller than 7pt
- NO heavy visual weight — everything should feel light and airy

"""Premium Figure 1: Two-stage multi-turn jailbreak detection architecture."""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, Circle
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe
import numpy as np

# ── Global style ──
plt.rcParams.update({
    "font.family": "serif",
    "font.serif": ["Times New Roman", "DejaVu Serif"],
    "font.size": 10,
    "text.usetex": False,
    "figure.facecolor": "white",
    "axes.facecolor": "white",
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=(15, 6.2), dpi=300)
ax.set_xlim(0, 15)
ax.set_ylim(0, 6.2)
ax.set_aspect("equal")
ax.axis("off")

# ── Color palette ──
C = {
    "bg_blue": "#D6EAF8", "border_blue": "#85C1E9", "deep_blue": "#2E86C1",
    "bg_purple": "#EDE7F6", "border_purple": "#B39DDB", "deep_purple": "#7E57C2",
    "bg_peach": "#FEF0E4", "border_peach": "#E59866", "deep_peach": "#A04000",
    "bg_cream": "#FEF9E7", "border_gold": "#D4AC0D", "deep_gold": "#7D6608",
    "bubble_bg": "#FAFBFC", "bubble_border": "#D5DBDB",
    "red_bg": "#FDEDEC", "red_border": "#E74C3C", "red_text": "#C0392B",
    "green_bg": "#EAFAF1", "green_border": "#27AE60", "green_text": "#1E8449",
    "text_dark": "#2C3E50", "text_mid": "#5D6D7E", "text_light": "#95A5A6",
    "arrow": "#B0BEC5", "teal": "#1ABC9C", "avatar": "#F1948A",
    "shadow": "#D5D8DC",
}

# ── Helper: rounded box with shadow ──
def draw_box(ax, x, y, w, h, bg, border, radius=0.15, shadow=True, lw=1.2, zorder=3):
    if shadow:
        shadow_box = FancyBboxPatch(
            (x + 0.04, y - 0.04), w, h,
            boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
            facecolor=C["shadow"], edgecolor="none", alpha=0.18, zorder=zorder - 1,
        )
        ax.add_patch(shadow_box)
    box = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x, y), w, h,
        boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
        facecolor=bg, edgecolor=border, linewidth=lw, zorder=zorder,
    )
    ax.add_patch(box)
    return box

def draw_gradient_box(ax, x, y, w, h, color_top, color_bot, border, radius=0.15, shadow=True, lw=1.2, zorder=3):
    if shadow:
        shadow_box = FancyBboxPatch(
            (x + 0.05, y - 0.05), w, h,
            boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
            facecolor="#C0C4C8", edgecolor="none", alpha=0.22, zorder=zorder - 1,
        )
        ax.add_patch(shadow_box)
    # Simulate gradient with multiple thin horizontal strips
    n_strips = 30
    from matplotlib.colors import to_rgba
    c_top = np.array(to_rgba(color_top))
    c_bot = np.array(to_rgba(color_bot))
    strip_h = h / n_strips
    for i in range(n_strips):
        frac = i / (n_strips - 1)
        c = c_top * (1 - frac) + c_bot * frac
        sy = y + h - (i + 1) * strip_h
        clip_radius = radius if (i == 0 or i == n_strips - 1) else 0.01
        strip = FancyBboxPatch(
            (x, sy), w, strip_h + 0.005,
            boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={clip_radius}",
            facecolor=c, edgecolor="none", zorder=zorder, clip_on=True,
        )
        ax.add_patch(strip)
    # Border on top
    border_box = FancyBboxPatch(
        (x, y), w, h,
        boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size={radius}",
        facecolor="none", edgecolor=border, linewidth=lw, zorder=zorder + 1,
    )
    ax.add_patch(border_box)

def draw_arrow(ax, xy_from, xy_to, color=None, lw=0.9, style="arc3,rad=0.04", zorder=5):
    if color is None:
        color = C["arrow"]
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch(
        xy_from, xy_to,
        arrowstyle="-|>",
        mutation_scale=8,
        color=color,
        linewidth=lw,
        connectionstyle=style,
        zorder=zorder,
    )
    ax.add_patch(arrow)

# ── Stage labels ──
ax.text(3.6, 5.85, "Stage 1:", fontsize=14.5, fontweight="bold", color=C["text_dark"],
        ha="right", va="center", fontfamily="serif")
ax.text(3.7, 5.85, "Encoder Adaptation", fontsize=14.5, fontweight="normal", color=C["text_dark"],
        ha="left", va="center", fontfamily="serif")
ax.text(10.2, 5.85, "Stage 2:", fontsize=14.5, fontweight="bold", color=C["text_dark"],
        ha="right", va="center", fontfamily="serif")
ax.text(10.3, 5.85, "Temporal Classification", fontsize=14.5, fontweight="normal", color=C["text_dark"],
        ha="left", va="center", fontfamily="serif")

# Dashed vertical separator
ax.plot([7.55, 7.55], [0.3, 5.65], ls="--", lw=0.7, color="#DEE2E6", zorder=1)

# ── Chat bubbles ──
bubble_texts = [
    "Can you help me\nwith...",
    "What if we\nconsider...",
    "But wouldn't it\nbe...",
    "So to\nsummarize...",
]
bubble_y_positions = [4.55, 3.45, 1.85, 0.75]
bubble_x = 0.7
bubble_w = 1.9
bubble_h = 0.72

# "k turns" bracket
ax.annotate("", xy=(0.25, 0.65), xytext=(0.25, 5.35),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="-", lw=0.6, color=C["text_light"]))
ax.plot([0.25, 0.35], [5.35, 5.35], lw=0.6, color=C["text_light"])
ax.plot([0.25, 0.35], [0.65, 0.65], lw=0.6, color=C["text_light"])
ax.text(0.15, 3.0, "k turns", fontsize=8, fontstyle="italic", color=C["text_light"],
        ha="center", va="center", rotation=90, fontfamily="sans-serif")

for i, (txt, by) in enumerate(zip(bubble_texts, bubble_y_positions)):
    # Ellipsis between bubble 2 and 3
    if i == 2:
        ax.text(bubble_x + bubble_w / 2 + 0.15, by + bubble_h + 0.2, "⋮",
                fontsize=14, color="#B0B0B0", ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)

    # Avatar circle
    avatar = Circle((bubble_x - 0.05, by + bubble_h / 2), 0.18,
                     facecolor=C["avatar"], edgecolor="white", linewidth=1.5, zorder=5)
    ax.add_patch(avatar)
    ax.text(bubble_x - 0.05, by + bubble_h / 2, "U", fontsize=7.5, fontweight="bold",
            color="white", ha="center", va="center", zorder=6, fontfamily="sans-serif")

    # Bubble
    draw_box(ax, bubble_x + 0.25, by, bubble_w, bubble_h, C["bubble_bg"], C["bubble_border"],
             radius=0.12, shadow=True, lw=0.8)

    # Speech tail (small triangle)
    tail_x = bubble_x + 0.25
    tail_y = by + bubble_h / 2
    triangle = plt.Polygon(
        [(tail_x, tail_y), (tail_x - 0.12, tail_y + 0.06), (tail_x - 0.0, tail_y + 0.12)],
        facecolor=C["bubble_bg"], edgecolor=C["bubble_border"], linewidth=0.8, zorder=4,
        closed=True
    )
    ax.add_patch(triangle)

    # Turn label
    subscript = f"$_{i+1}$" if i < 3 else "$_k$"
    ax.text(bubble_x + 0.4, by + bubble_h - 0.12, f"User{subscript}",
            fontsize=7, color=C["text_light"], va="top", fontfamily="sans-serif", fontstyle="italic", zorder=7)
    ax.text(bubble_x + 0.4, by + 0.12, f"\"{txt.replace(chr(10), ' ')}\"",
            fontsize=8, color=C["text_dark"], va="bottom", fontfamily="sans-serif",
            zorder=7, linespacing=1.15)

# ── DeBERTa encoder box ──
enc_x, enc_y, enc_w, enc_h = 3.7, 1.6, 2.7, 3.2
draw_gradient_box(ax, enc_x, enc_y, enc_w, enc_h, "#D6EAF8", "#B3D9F2", C["border_blue"],
                  radius=0.18, shadow=True, lw=1.3)

# Document icon inside encoder
doc_x, doc_y = enc_x + enc_w/2 - 0.25, enc_y + enc_h - 0.9
for j, dy in enumerate([0, -0.18, -0.36]):
    line_w = 0.5 if j < 2 else 0.3
    ax.plot([doc_x, doc_x + line_w], [doc_y + dy, doc_y + dy],
            lw=1.5, color=C["border_blue"], alpha=0.35, zorder=5)

ax.text(enc_x + enc_w / 2, enc_y + enc_h / 2 - 0.15, "DeBERTa-v3-base",
        fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", color=C["text_dark"],
        ha="center", va="center", zorder=6, fontfamily="serif")
ax.text(enc_x + enc_w / 2, enc_y + enc_h / 2 - 0.6, "shared weights",
        fontsize=8.5, fontstyle="italic", color=C["text_mid"],
        ha="center", va="center", zorder=6, fontfamily="sans-serif")

# ── Arrows: bubbles → encoder ──
for by in bubble_y_positions:
    arrow_from = (bubble_x + 0.25 + bubble_w, by + bubble_h / 2)
    arrow_to = (enc_x, by + bubble_h / 2 if by + bubble_h/2 > enc_y and by + bubble_h/2 < enc_y + enc_h
                else enc_y + enc_h / 2)
    # Clamp to encoder box
    target_y = max(enc_y + 0.2, min(enc_y + enc_h - 0.2, by + bubble_h / 2))
    draw_arrow(ax, arrow_from, (enc_x, target_y), lw=0.8, style="arc3,rad=0.05")

# ── Hidden state pills ──
h_x = 6.8
h_labels = ["h₁", "h₂", "h₃", "hₖ"]
h_ys = [4.4, 3.5, 1.9, 1.0]
pill_w, pill_h = 0.55, 0.4

# "frozen [CLS]" annotation
ax.text(h_x + pill_w / 2, 5.3, "frozen [CLS]  ❄", fontsize=8.5, color=C["teal"],
        ha="center", va="center", fontfamily="sans-serif", fontstyle="italic", zorder=6)

for i, (label, hy) in enumerate(zip(h_labels, h_ys)):
    if i == 2:
        ax.text(h_x + pill_w / 2, hy + pill_h + 0.25, "⋮",
                fontsize=12, color="#B0B0B0", ha="center", va="center", zorder=5)

    draw_box(ax, h_x, hy, pill_w, pill_h, "#EBF5FB", C["border_blue"],
             radius=0.12, shadow=False, lw=0.8)
    ax.text(h_x + pill_w / 2, hy + pill_h / 2, f"${label[0]}_{{{label[1:]}}}$",
            fontsize=10, color=C["deep_blue"], ha="center", va="center", zorder=6,
            fontfamily="serif", fontstyle="italic")

    # Arrow: encoder → pill
    draw_arrow(ax, (enc_x + enc_w, max(enc_y + 0.2, min(enc_y + enc_h - 0.2, hy + pill_h / 2))),
               (h_x, hy + pill_h / 2), lw=0.7, style="arc3,rad=0.02")

# ── "t →" annotation ──
ax.text(8.4, 5.3, "t →", fontsize=9, fontstyle="italic", color=C["text_light"],
        ha="center", va="center", fontfamily="sans-serif")

# ── BiGRU box ──
gru_x, gru_y, gru_w, gru_h = 8.0, 1.8, 1.9, 2.6
draw_gradient_box(ax, gru_x, gru_y, gru_w, gru_h, "#EDE7F6", "#D1C4E9", C["border_purple"],
                  radius=0.15, shadow=True, lw=1.3)

# Bidirectional arrow icon inside
ax.annotate("", xy=(gru_x + gru_w/2 + 0.3, gru_y + gru_h - 0.55),
            xytext=(gru_x + gru_w/2 - 0.3, gru_y + gru_h - 0.55),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->", color=C["border_purple"], lw=1, alpha=0.4))

ax.text(gru_x + gru_w / 2, gru_y + gru_h / 2, "BiGRU",
        fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", color=C["deep_purple"],
        ha="center", va="center", zorder=6, fontfamily="serif")

# Arrows: pills → BiGRU
for hy in h_ys:
    target_y = max(gru_y + 0.2, min(gru_y + gru_h - 0.2, hy + pill_h / 2))
    draw_arrow(ax, (h_x + pill_w, hy + pill_h / 2), (gru_x, target_y),
               lw=0.7, style="arc3,rad=0.03")

# ── MLP box ──
mlp_x, mlp_y, mlp_w, mlp_h = 10.6, 2.1, 1.7, 2.0
draw_gradient_box(ax, mlp_x, mlp_y, mlp_w, mlp_h, "#FEF0E4", "#F5CBA7", C["border_peach"],
                  radius=0.15, shadow=True, lw=1.3)

# Network icon inside MLP
net_cx, net_cy = mlp_x + mlp_w / 2, mlp_y + mlp_h - 0.55
for dx in [-0.2, 0, 0.2]:
    for dy in [0, -0.25]:
        c = Circle((net_cx + dx, net_cy + dy), 0.06,
                    facecolor=C["border_peach"], edgecolor="none", alpha=0.35, zorder=5)
        ax.add_patch(c)

ax.text(mlp_x + mlp_w / 2, mlp_y + mlp_h / 2 - 0.05, "MLP",
        fontsize=13, fontweight="bold", color=C["deep_peach"],
        ha="center", va="center", zorder=6, fontfamily="serif")

# Arrow: BiGRU → MLP
draw_arrow(ax, (gru_x + gru_w, gru_y + gru_h / 2), (mlp_x, mlp_y + mlp_h / 2),
           lw=1.0, style="arc3,rad=0.0")

# "shared across all 7 variants" annotation
ax.text((gru_x + mlp_x + mlp_w) / 2, 1.35, "shared across all 7 variants",
        fontsize=8, fontstyle="italic", color=C["text_light"],
        ha="center", va="center", fontfamily="sans-serif")

# ── Output pills ──
out_x = 13.0
out_w, out_h = 1.5, 0.5

# Jailbreak
jb_y = 3.8
draw_box(ax, out_x, jb_y, out_w, out_h, C["red_bg"], C["red_border"],
         radius=0.2, shadow=True, lw=1.0)
ax.text(out_x + 0.25, jb_y + out_h / 2, "▲", fontsize=7, color=C["red_text"],
        ha="center", va="center", zorder=6)
ax.text(out_x + out_w / 2 + 0.1, jb_y + out_h / 2, "Jailbreak",
        fontsize=10.5, fontweight="bold", color=C["red_text"],
        ha="center", va="center", zorder=6, fontfamily="serif")

# Benign

draw_box(ax, out_x, bn_y, out_w, out_h, C["green_bg"], C["green_border"],
         radius=0.2, shadow=True, lw=1.0)
ax.text(out_x + 0.25, bn_y + out_h / 2, "✓", fontsize=9, color=C["green_text"],
        ha="center", va="center", zorder=6, fontweight="bold")
ax.text(out_x + out_w / 2 + 0.1, bn_y + out_h / 2, "Benign",
        fontsize=10.5, fontweight="bold", color=C["green_text"],
        ha="center", va="center", zorder=6, fontfamily="serif")

# Arrows: MLP → outputs
draw_arrow(ax, (mlp_x + mlp_w, mlp_y + mlp_h * 0.7), (out_x, jb_y + out_h / 2),
           lw=0.9, style="arc3,rad=-0.08")
draw_arrow(ax, (mlp_x + mlp_w, mlp_y + mlp_h * 0.3), (out_x, bn_y + out_h / 2),
           lw=0.9, style="arc3,rad=0.08")

# ── DAPT variants box ──
dapt_x, dapt_y, dapt_w, dapt_h = 3.5, 0.15, 3.1, 1.15
# Dashed border box
dapt_box = FancyBboxPatch(
    (dapt_x, dapt_y), dapt_w, dapt_h,
    boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.12",
    facecolor=C["bg_cream"], edgecolor=C["border_gold"],
    linewidth=1.2, linestyle="--", zorder=3,
)
ax.add_patch(dapt_box)
# Shadow

    (dapt_x + 0.04, dapt_y - 0.04), dapt_w, dapt_h,
    boxstyle=f"round,pad=0,rounding_size=0.12",
    facecolor=C["shadow"], edgecolor="none", alpha=0.1, zorder=2,
)
ax.add_patch(dapt_shadow)

ax.text(dapt_x + dapt_w / 2, dapt_y + dapt_h - 0.2, "×7 Stage-1 Objectives",
        fontsize=9.5, fontweight="bold", color=C["deep_gold"],
        ha="center", va="center", zorder=6, fontfamily="serif")
ax.text(dapt_x + dapt_w / 2, dapt_y + dapt_h / 2 - 0.15,
        "9-Class  ·  Binary  ·  Scrambled  ·  MLM",
        fontsize=7.5, color="#8D7B09", ha="center", va="center", zorder=6, fontfamily="sans-serif")
ax.text(dapt_x + dapt_w / 2, dapt_y + dapt_h / 2 - 0.42,

        fontsize=7.5, color="#8D7B09", ha="center", va="center", zorder=6, fontfamily="sans-serif")
